title: Lubiechów Palm House
visualBrief: Tall brick-and-glass Palm House with green barrel roof, roof lantern and glazed polygonal porch; connected low glasshouse ranges enclose two true open courtyards.

nativeAxes.origin: Own connected glasshouse envelope center; Y0 interpreted local ground

sourceFacts.primaryDescription: Own named OSM relation3532583. Operator describes a15m metal/glass hall with surrounding single-storey orangeries and a roof viewing gallery. Current operator photographs support the central facade/roof; unseen glasshouse divisions and dimensions are interpretations.

reconstruction.basis: Own OSM relation outer ring and two courtyard holes, official 2025 scope plan, current operator page and exterior/interior gallery.
reconstruction.scope: Central Palm House and connected surrounding glasshouse ranges. Independent greenhouse group, boiler, administration, utility building, residence and landscape remain separate pending parts.
reconstruction.heightDatum: Operator central hall is described as 15m; this model uses Y0 to lantern apex15m. Other roof/wall subdivisions and unseen elevations are estimates; shared terrain datum unmeasured.

geographicProposal.notes: Own connected Palm House multipolygon, two true courtyard holes and main entrance. Central facade direction is supported by mapped entrance and operator exterior photos. Other facade/roof subdivisions and shared terrain datum remain estimated; activation pending geographic review.
